children: New Delhi, Oct. 4 -- Upcoming dividend, stock split, bonus share this week, October 5-9: Shares of NMDC, PH Capital, MoldTek Technologies, PTC India, GTV Engineering Limited are set to attract heightened investors' interest in the upcoming week due to their record dates for corporate actions.

Nearly 15 companies have fixed record date for corporate actions like dividend, stock split, bonus issue, spin off, etc. For investors who closely track such corporate actions, here are all the details about upcoming dividend, bonus, stock split record dates.

NMDC, PTC India, Accelya Solutions India, Caspian Corporate Services, Skyways Air Services, etc have announced interim dividends; their record dates will fall in the upcoming week. Additionally, GTV Engineering, PH Capital, MoldTek Technologies, MoldTek Packaging Limited, etc have fixed record dates for stock split.

The Indian stock market ended lower for the seventh consecutive week. Nifty 50 closed 0.78% lower at 22,421.95 points, whereas BSE Sensex closed 0.60% lower at 71,909 points. The Indian stock market is likely to see heightened volatility in the upcoming week.

For Nifty 50, "a move above Thursday's high of 22,610 will signal a pullback towards the 22,800 and 23,000 levels. However, for a meaningful trend reversal index would require forming a sustained Higher High-Higher Low structure and reclaim the 23,000-23,100 level. Failure to move above 22,610 will lead to some consolidation in the range of 22,600-22,200 levels," explained Pabitro Mukherjee, Deputy Vice President-Research, Bajaj Broking.
